subject: National park fee-free day on Veterans Day 2026
query: are national parks free on veterans day
title: Are national parks free on Veterans Day 2026? Yes, with a new limit
answer: Yes. On Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, Veterans Day, the National Park Service waives entrance fees at parks that normally charge them. Starting in 2026, though, fee-free days apply only to U.S. citizens and residents. International visitors still pay, including a new $100 nonresident fee at 11 popular parks.
body:
Nov. 11 is the last of the National Park Service's 2026 free entrance days. The others were Feb. 16 (Presidents Day), May 25 (Memorial Day), June 14 (Flag Day), July 3-5 (Independence Day weekend), Aug. 25 (the Park Service's birthday), Sept. 17 (Constitution Day) and Oct. 27 (Theodore Roosevelt's birthday). The NPS passes page says: "Beginning in 2026, free entrance on these days will be for US citizens and residents only." The waiver covers entrance fees only; Yosemite notes that timed-entry or reservation fees may still apply.

Nonresidents age 16 and older now pay $100 on top of the regular entrance fee at Acadia, Bryce Canyon, Everglades, Glacier, Grand Canyon, Grand Teton, Rocky Mountain, Sequoia & Kings Canyon, Yellowstone, Yosemite and Zion. That fee is waived for holders of an America the Beautiful pass. The annual pass costs $80 for U.S. residents and $250 for nonresidents.

Veterans and Gold Star Family members can get a free Military Lifetime Pass, and current U.S. military members and their dependents get a free Military Annual Pass, so they can enter free all year.
in_the_news: Nov. 11, 2026, is the final national park fee-free day of the year and the first Veterans Day under the 2026 rule limiting free entry to U.S. citizens and residents.

faq.q: Are national parks free on Nov. 11, 2026?
faq.a: Yes, for U.S. citizens and residents. Entrance fees are waived at all NPS sites that normally charge them.

faq.q: Do foreign tourists get in free on Veterans Day?
faq.a: No. Since 2026, fee-free days apply only to U.S. citizens and residents.

faq.q: Which national parks charge the $100 nonresident fee?
faq.a: Acadia, Bryce Canyon, Everglades, Glacier, Grand Canyon, Grand Teton, Rocky Mountain, Sequoia & Kings Canyon, Yellowstone, Yosemite and Zion.

faq.q: Do veterans get into national parks free?
faq.a: Yes. Veterans can get a free Military Lifetime Pass from the NPS.

faq.q: What are the free national park days in 2026?
faq.a: Feb. 16, May 25, June 14, July 3-5, Aug. 25, Sept. 17, Oct. 27 and Nov. 11.
